title: German Courgette Fritters
description: A classic German recipe for crispy courgette fritters with a crunchy exterior and a tender interior. This dish is perfect as a side or as a snack.
instructions: Grate the courgette and set aside.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, eggs, milk, salt, and pepper.
Add the grated courgette to the bowl and stir until well combined.
Heat the butter in a large frying pan over medium heat.
Using a spoon, drop small amounts of the courgette mixture into the pan and flatten slightly.
Cook for 3-4 minutes on each side, or until golden brown and crispy.
